meta.title: URL Tracking Parameter Cleaner - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Batch remove tracking parameters (utm, fbclid, gclid, etc.) from URLs to restore clean links.
desc: Batch remove tracking parameters (utm, fbclid, gclid, etc.) from URLs to restore clean links.
ui.3: non-empty lines contain spaces and are not valid URLs, kept as-is
ui.100: Paste one URL per line. Tracking parameters such as utm_*, fbclid, gclid, mc_cid, mc_eid, yclid, igshid, twclid, li_fat_id, ref_src, ref_url, spm, from, from_channel will be removed (case-insensitive); all other parameters and anchors are kept.
